description_expanded: ABOUT 30A HIDEAWAY Welcome to 30A Hideaway, a stylish and newly renovated townhome tucked into the sought-after Inlet Beach area along Scenic 30A. Designed with a clean, modern coastal aesthetic, this 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom retreat sleeps up to 6 guests and offers an easy blend of comfort, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location. Just a short walk from the beach, the home opens into a bright, airy living space where the kitchen, dining, and lounge areas come together effortlessly-perfect for slow mornings, post-beach afternoons, and easy nights in. Upstairs, the king suite offers a quiet escape of its own, complete with a private balcony and Gulf views, giving you a peaceful place to start your day with coffee or wind down as the sun sets. Every detail has been considered, from the fully equipped kitchen and coffee maker (Keurig and drip) to Smart TV, WiFi, washer and dryer, and flexible sleeping arrangements with a sleeper sofa for additional guests. What makes 30A Hideaway special is how easy everything feels. You can walk to the beach in minutes, hop on a bike and cruise along 30A, or spend the day exploring nearby towns like Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. And when you come back, it's quiet, comfortable, and exactly where you want to be. ABOUT THE AREA 30A Hideaway is located in Inlet Beach, one of the most desirable and laid-back communities along Scenic 30A. This area is known for its wide beaches, relaxed atmosphere, and close proximity to some of the most iconic beach towns along the Emerald Coast. Nearby attractions include: * Beach access less than a 5-minute walk away * Rosemary Beach shops and restaurants * Scenic 30A bike path * Camp Helen State Park * Local dining, coffee shops, and coastal boutiques Scenic 30A is a stretch of coastline known for its charming beach communities, outdoor activities, and relaxed coastal lifestyle, making it one of Florida's most sought-after vacation destinations. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * Gulf Views from Private Balcony * Less Than 5-Minute Walk to the Beach * Newly Renovated Interior * Open-Concept Living Space * Fully Equipped Kitchen * Beach Gear Available for Guest Use * Outdoor Gas Grill * Fenced Yard * Covered Parking PARKING * 3 Designated Parking Spaces * Covered Parking Available PROPERTY RULES * Must be 25 years or older to book * Maximum occupancy: 6 guests * No smoking permitted * Rental agreement must be signed within 48 hours of booking or reservation is subject to cancellation * All reservations are non-refundable - travel insurance is strongly encouraged DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class service from inquiry to checkout. All homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standards. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create unforgettable memories - one beach vacation at a time.
